logo.source: Made for this build: src/components/Logo.tsx (gable mark + name in Cormorant italic) and src/app/icon.svg (favicon)

typefaces.source: Google Fonts via next/font (self-hosted): Cormorant 500/600 normal+italic, Karla 400/500

finalCopy.source: src/content/site.ts — written from the owner line; names, quotes, numbers, address and dates marked PLACEHOLDER for the owner to replace

photographySet.source: Owner's photos (Unsplash, credited in media-src/SOURCES.md), graded and cropped in public/media/
